Activated carbon and gas cleaning patents are not related to hydrogen storage or generation, e.g., 'Device and method for controlling screening size of exhaust sintering gas activated carbon'.

Magnet recycling patents mention hydrogen gas capture but focus on recycling, e.g., 'Acid ndfeb magnet recycling'.
Chemical process patents using hydrogen fluoride are not related to hydrogen storage, e.g., 'Improvements in or relating to an akylation process'.
